import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def power(a, t, P):
    r = 1
    while t:
        if t & 1:
            r = (r * a) % P
        a = (a * a) % P
        t >>= 1
    return r

data = input().split()
L, K, P = map(int, data[:3])

fac = [1] * (L + 1)
bitcnt = [0] * (L + 1)
for i in range(1, L + 1):
    fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % P
    bitcnt[i] = bitcnt[i >> 1] + (i & 1)

all_power = power(K, L, P)
if L & 1:
    print(all_power)
    sys.exit()

ifac = [1] * (L + 1)
ifac[L] = power(fac[L], P - 2, P)
for i in range(L, 0, -1):
    ifac[i - 1] = (ifac[i] * i) % P

n = 0
bit_list = []
i = 0
while (1 << i) <= L:
    if (L >> i) & 1:
        bit_list.append(1 << i)
        n += 1
    i += 1

m = 1 << n
suma = [[0] * m for _ in range(19)]
sumc = [[0] * m for _ in range(19)]
dp = [[0] * m for _ in range(19)]
tmp = [[0] * m for _ in range(19)]

for i in range(m):
    s = 0
    for j in range(n):
        if (i >> j) & 1:
            s += bit_list[j]
    suma[bitcnt[i]][i] = ifac[s]

for t in range(n + 1):
    length = m
    while length >= 2:
        half = length >> 1
        for j in range(0, m, length):
            for k in range(half):
                suma[t][j + k + half] += suma[t][j + k]
        length >>= 1
    for j in range(m):
        suma[t][j] %= P

for t in range(n + 1):
    for j in range(m):
        dp[t][j] = suma[t][j]

cc = 0
revK = 0
temp_K = K
while temp_K:
    revK = (revK << 1) | (temp_K & 1)
    cc += 1
    temp_K >>= 1
cc -= 1

for _ in range(cc, -1, -1):
    for t in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(m):
            tmp[t][j] = 0
    for a in range(n + 1):
        for b in range(n - a + 1):
            f = tmp[a + b]
            g = dp[a]
            h = dp[b]
            for j in range(m):
                f[j] += g[j] * h[j]
    for t in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(m):
            dp[t][j] = tmp[t][j] % P

    if (revK & 1):
        for t in range(n + 1):
            for j in range(m):
                tmp[t][j] = 0
        for a in range(n + 1):
            for b in range(n - a + 1):
                f = tmp[a + b]
                g = dp[a]
                h = suma[b]
                for j in range(m):
                    f[j] += g[j] * h[j]
        for t in range(n + 1):
            for j in range(m):
                dp[t][j] = tmp[t][j] % P
        revK >>= 1

for t in range(n + 1):
    for j in range(m):
        sumc[t][j] = dp[t][j]

for t in range(n + 1):
    length = 2
    while length <= m:
        half = length >> 1
        for j in range(0, m, length):
            for k in range(half):
                sumc[t][j + k + half] -= sumc[t][j + k]
        length <<= 1
    for j in range(m):
        sumc[t][j] = (sumc[t][j] % P + P) % P

result = (all_power - sumc[n][(1 << n) - 1] * fac[L] % P + P) % P
print(result)
